verdict.rationale: Omnichannel handling is a fair question for a team-oriented inbox product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only email handling. The AI integrations with Slack, HubSpot, Zapier and MCP connect the assistant to other apps; they do not bring SMS, WhatsApp, social or live-chat conversations into the inbox. The Workspaces/chat mentioned by a community user is internal team chat, not a customer channel.
